The cabin is 30 square meters, and has 1 bedroom and 1 galleried bedroom, 1 bathroom, living room, kitchen and terrace. It is located in Brenna, about 36 kilometers from Svolvær, and has a sea view. You can see the midnight sun from mid-May until mid-July, and the northern lights from September until April. Brenna is a quiet place surrounded by beautiful mountains and nature. The nearest grocery store is in Kabelvåg, 25 minutes from the cabin.
